question: From (3)/(4) of a number P, Ramakrishna subtracts (2)/(3) of another number Q and obtain (5)/(8) as the difference. What is the answer Ramakrishna should obtain if he subtracts eight times of Q from nine times of P?
solution:
Given:

From (3)/(4) of a number P, Ramakrishna subtracts (2)/(3) of another number Q and obtain (5)/(8) as the difference.

Calculation:

(3)/(4) of a number P = (3P)/(4)

(2)/(3) of number Q = (2Q)/(3)

According to the question,

(3P)/(4) - (2Q)/(3) = (5)/(8)

⇒ {(9P - 8Q) over 12} = {5 over 8}

⇒ {(9P - 8Q) over 3} = {5 over 2}

⇒ 9P - 8Q = {5 times 3} over 2

⇒ 9P - 8Q = {15} over 2

**∴ The answer Ramakrishna should obtain is {15} over 2 if he subtracts eight times of Q from nine times of P.**
